name: roots-sh
description: The dev tool roots roots.sh and its Jet twin orchestrator/Roots.jet (#5072 c9): a root is the environment's value, else what the machine's ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/jet/env sets it to, else the default derived from $HOME and the XDG directories. Sourced, roots.sh exports the roots; run by bash with root names, it prints `NAME=value` for each, as Roots.jet does, and exits 64 at a name that is not a root. Every case sets every root (empty is unset, as all three programs read it) so the machine's own leak into nothing, and the XDG data and config directories are relative so no path names the machine. XDG_CACHE_HOME stays the machine's, because the harness starts both programs through Tools/agent/JetEnv.jet, which keeps its dev shells there; check.jet writes the machine's cache directory as `$XDG_CACHE_HOME`. fixtures/cfg/jet/env is a machine's env file: quoted and bare values, `export`, a `${NAME:-default}` value that keeps the environment's, a name set twice, and an XDG directory the defaults then derive from. The cases cover the defaults, the environment over the defaults, the env file over the environment and under it, a name that is not a root after one that is, and no name.
